name: Nanamori Souya
source:
A regular pervert who targets women who are in love.
He is a college student, but he is also a handsome man with a good-looking face.
He makes a living as a pimp for his female friends and pays them tribute.
He is interested in the love of a woman with big tits he sees on the train, and decides to make her a target for his molestation.
He never takes any lovers, but he has been with countless women and has a reputation for being a slut.
